assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished wide landscape presentation image.
Original luxury redesign proposal for the Traditional Chinese Group SNE-derived Winner's Circle / Royal Turf board game, 皇家賽馬場. This is a 3D product concept rendering, not a retail reproduction. The actual seven horse identities are WHITE, BLACK, PINK, BLUE, YELLOW, GREEN, ORANGE, in that order. Never substitute red or purple. Refined editorial product visualization; believable geometry, crisp readable contours, physically based materials, balanced studio lighting, no casino clutter, no brand logos.
Art direction A: ROYAL CLUB. heritage private equestrian club. Smoked walnut burl, deep racing-green leather/felt, warm ivory letterpress stock, restrained brushed champagne-brass details. Understated, tailored, quiet wealth, magnificent real material tactility. Warm studio lighting. Cream editorial background.
Create a premium full-board concept presentation. One large elevated three-quarter isometric hero view of a complete rectangular tabletop game board, plus one smaller clean overhead plan inset and three tiny material samples. The board has ONE continuous oval racing path divided into 36 generous discrete cells, a single sequence, not seven racing lanes. Place a single clear start/finish stripe and a small pace medal marked 18 on the far side. Seven small an anatomically convincing thoroughbred in a controlled racing stride, powerful slender silhouette, carefully sculpted mane and tail, satin opaque enamel whole body, tiny brass tack detail, no rider, on a slim oval walnut-and-brass plinth horse tokens in the seven correct colours are on seven successive cells near the start. Integrate EXACTLY SEVEN card/betting bays along the near edge, colours white black pink blue yellow green orange, each with a card seat and a separate generous chip well that never covers movement values. Infield includes an orderly payout panel, three low finish podium positions 1 2 3, a discrete last-place position, and a subtle race I II III selector. No grandstand or tall scenery obscuring the track. Typography clean and restrained. Large title "A / ROYAL CLUB", smaller "BOARD • 3D CONCEPT". This should look like a bespoke collector's object that translates beautifully to an interactive browser tabletop. Board dominates frame, no room interior. Conspicuously readable spaces and betting bays, thin elegant construction.
assets.revision: Remove track numbers and invented payout values; preserve composition, seven colours and bays, material study only.
assets.revisionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this exact luxury walnut and green tabletop board concept. Preserve the beautiful composition, materials, seven horse colours, seven betting bays, podium and material samples. Remove ALL little numbers printed on the track cells, leave the individual track cells and their boundaries intact but UNNUMBERED. Retain the pace medal 18 and the finish stripe. Replace the erroneous payout panel numbers with a fine empty ruled table and title PAYOUTS only. Keep the visible title A / ROYAL CLUB and BOARD • 3D CONCEPT; remove all invented tiny lifestyle slogans and filler copy. Do not redesign anything else. It is a clean material study; exact game typography will be supplied separately.
